subject: Bayern beat Atletico 2-0 at the Metropolitano as 18-year-old Lennart Karl breaks a record
title: A teenager joins Raul, Mbappe and Yamal

lines.vo: Five Champions League goals before nineteen. Only three players managed it first.
lines.footage: Lennart Karl goal Atletico, Bayern Champions League

lines.vo: Lennart Karl chipped Jan Oblak in the fifty-fourth minute. Cheeky. No apology offered.
lines.footage: Lennart Karl goal Atletico, chip over Oblak

lines.vo: He joins Lamine Yamal, Kylian Mbappe and Raul. A very short list.
Konrad Laimer added a second in the seventy-fourth minute, from a lofted Harry Kane pass.
lines.footage: Laimer goal Atletico Bayern, Kane assist

lines.vo: Assistant Aaron Danks was in charge. Bayern still won two-nil.
Atletico sat twenty-third of thirty-six, and have never won the Champions League. Bayern made the wait longer.
lines.footage: Atletico Champions League history, Metropolitano; league phase table

facts_used: Lennart Karl became the fourth player to reach five Champions League goals before turning 19, after Lamine Yamal, Kylian Mbappe and Raul (ev0094)
Karl scored at 54 minutes, chipping Jan Oblak; Konrad Laimer added a second at 74 minutes from a lofted Harry Kane pass (ev0094)
Atletico left with 4 points from four games and 23rd of 36 in the league phase table (ev0094)
Assistant Aaron Danks was in charge that night (ev0094)
Atletico have never won the Champions League (ev0094 background)
notes: Non-comic, 0 inserts, EL 600-char limit. The absence of Vincent Kompany is not mentioned, since the record gives a medical reason for it. Atletico never-won claim comes from the background field of the record. Hook now names all three earlier players (Yamal, Mbappe, Raul) as in ev0094. Jokes target the chip, the short list and Atletico's trophy wait; nothing personal.
